G1.label: Opus-class, in-session
G1.execution: main session, all 40 items in one context
G1.independence: NOT independent - same context that authored the items and gold references

G3.label: Haiku-class, cold subagent
G3.execution: cold subagent, fresh context, rubric + items only
G3.independence: independent of every other rater and of item authoring

GH.label: Non-expert human rater, rubric-trained
GH.execution: manual, 15 of 40 items, one item at a time, no other rater's scores shown
GH.independence: independent; does NOT validate the legal correctness of the gold references

G2.label: Sonnet-class, API
G2.execution: API, one independent call per item, extended thinking disabled, own presentation order
G2.independence: independent - fresh context per item, no access to other raters or to item authoring

G4.label: Opus-class, API
G4.execution: API, one independent call per item, extended thinking disabled, own presentation order
G4.independence: independent - fresh context per item, no access to other raters or to item authoring

G4b.label: Opus-class, API, second run
G4b.execution: API, one independent call per item, different presentation order, same prompt
G4b.independence: repeat of G4 - measures intra-rater (test-retest) reliability, not between-rater

G2b.label: Sonnet-class, API, second run
G2b.execution: API, one independent call per item, different presentation order, same prompt
G2b.independence: repeat of G2 - measures intra-rater (test-retest) reliability, not between-rater

G4ng.label: Opus-class, API, gold reference withheld
G4ng.execution: API, one independent call per item, gold reference removed from the prompt
G4ng.independence: ablation of G4 - measures how much of the agreement the answer key was doing
